svg.title: PID comparison: saturation release
svg.desc: Synthetic reduced DC motor. Reference drops from 140 to 60 rad/s at 4 s. Conditional integration recovers sooner for this configuration. No hardware validation.
svg.text: Synthetic motor | dt = 0.01 s | input limit = +/-12 V | same PID gains
Blue: PID | Green: PID + anti-windup | Gray: reference | Dashed: event at 4 s
SYNTHETIC SIMULATION - NOT HARDWARE VALIDATED. Results apply to this configuration.
